overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）。方法上以蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（11 篇）、NBER（1 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Revealing Structured Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study models of restricted heterogeneity. While the random utility model allows for arbitrary heterogeneity among rational types, we consider the case when an analyst ex-ante restricts the set of rational types to some smaller set of allowable types. We study the behavioral content, the model fit, and the identification properties of restrictions of this form. We find that all three of these can be connected through a common value function that is constructed from observable data. Consistency with a model of restricted heterogeneity is characterized by this value function achieving a value of one, while model fit is given by a value that is potentially less than one. The partially identified set for a given model of restricted heterogeneity is characterized by way of the subdifferential of this value function.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文研究分析师预先将理性类型限制在较小允许集合中的受限异质性模型，并探讨其行为内容、模型拟合度及识别性质。

🔬 研究方法：研究通过构建一个基于可观测数据的共同价值函数，来连接行为内容、模型拟合度与识别性质，并利用该函数的次微分来刻画模型的识别集。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，模型一致性由该值函数取值为1来表征，而模型拟合度则由该函数的取值（可能小于1）给出，且受限异质性模型的识别集由该值函数的次微分刻画。

💡 应用价值：该研究为分析师在受限异质性框架下评估模型拟合度、一致性及识别性提供了统一的框架和工具。

papers.title: Regime Detection in Latent Factor Models -- A Bayesian Decision-Theoretic Approach
papers.abstract: Regime-switching multi-factor models are widely used in quantitative finance, but filtering does not by itself determine when an agent should act on inferred regime changes. We formulate online regime detection with latent factors and hidden regimes as a Bayesian decision problem balancing false alarms, detection delay, and misclassification. Since posterior regime probabilities are generally non-Markovian, the problem is represented as a measure-valued optimal stopping problem and approximated using particle filtering with Monte Carlo dynamic programming. A single-change-point Heston model provides a benchmark. With observed variance, the problem reduces to a two-dimensional Markov free-boundary problem, while under latent variance decisions are based on the filtered posterior measure. Numerical experiments in Heston and regime-switching Vasicek models show that the latent-information procedure can outperform feasible plug-in rules.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】制度转换多因子模型在定量金融领域被广泛使用，但仅依靠过滤机制本身无法确定代理人应在何时根据推断出的制度变化采取行动。我们将带有潜在因子和隐藏制度的在线制度检测问题构建为一个贝叶斯决策问题，该问题需要在误报、检测延迟和错误分类之间进行权衡。由于后验制度概率通常具有非马尔可夫特性，该问题被表述为一个测度值最优停止问题，并通过结合粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划的方法进行近似求解。Heston模型中的单变点情形为该问题提供了一个基准模型；在观测到方差信息的情况下，问题可简化为二维马尔可夫自由边界问题；而在存在潜在方差的情况下，决策则基于过滤后的后验测度。在Heston模型和制度转换Vasicek模型中的数值实验表明，基于潜在信息的决策方法能够优于传统的插值规则。。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法、因子模型。

papers.title: The Relationship between Income and Health: Evidence from Nationwide Health Exams in Korea
papers.abstract: We examine how physical health, health behaviors, and mortality vary with income for prime-age adults. To do so, we leverage population-wide, individual-level cardiovascular health exams linked to income tax records and subsequent mortality for a representative sample of about 350,000 Koreans aged 47--57. For both men and women, there is a negative disease-income gradient for high blood pressure, high blood glucose, and high body mass index, but not for high cholesterol. Disease-income gradients are steeper for women than men, and tend to be concentrated in the top half of the income distribution; similar patterns hold for health behavior-income gradients. Subsequent mortality-income gradients are also concentrated in the top half of the income distribution, but are steeper for men than women. Although physical health and behavior measures are highly predictive of subsequent mortality, differences in these measures by income explain very little of the income-mortality gradient, even for cardiovascular mortality. Our findings suggest that something other than differences in disease burden at prime age drives most of the income-mortality gradient at older ages.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了身体健康状况、健康行为以及死亡率如何随收入水平在壮年人群中发生变化。为此，我们利用了涵盖全国范围、针对个体水平的心血管健康检查数据，并将这些数据与所得税记录以及约35万名47至57岁韩国人的后续死亡数据进行了关联分析。研究发现，对于高血压、高血糖和高体重指数而言，疾病与收入之间存在负相关关系（即收入越高，相关健康问题越严重）；然而高胆固醇与收入之间并未呈现这种负相关关系。女性群体的这种疾病-收入关联趋势比男性更为明显，且主要集中在收入分配的上半部分；健康行为与收入之间的关联模式也类似。后续死亡率与收入之间的关联同样主要集中在收入分配的上半部分，但男性的相关程度高于女性。尽管身体健康状况和健康行为指标能够很好地预测后续死亡率，但这些指标在不同收入群体间的差异对于解释整体收入-死亡率关系（包括心血管疾病导致的死亡率）的作用非常有限。我们的研究结果表明，在老年阶段，收入-死亡率关系的主要驱动因素并非仅仅是壮年时期的疾病负担差异。。

papers.title: Auction-based allocation of routes in capacity-constrained networks
papers.abstract: We study the route-set allocation problem between end nodes in capacity-constrained flow networks with transfer costs. We introduce an origin--destination (OD) bidding language, in which a participant bids for bounded conic combinations of inlet--outlet--quantity licences and the mechanism performs the routing through a network-flow optimising winner-determination problem. We then study payment rules for the OD mechanism. Under a restricted model with openly and uniformly priced sources and bidders who are indifferent to the source of the gas, the Vickrey--Clarke--Groves (VCG) payment is core-stable; the key structural fact is that in this regime some optimal aggregate flows never use a physical pipe in both directions, so the winner-determination problem reduces to a single-commodity network flow whose value is submodular in the set of active bidders. If source access is allowed to depend on the individual consumer -- a realistic feature, e.g. when gas deals are embedded in bilateral political bargaining -- the reduction fails and VCG payments may lie strictly outside the core. For this general model we propose a dual (nodal) pricing rule derived from the shadow prices of the flow-conservation constraints, and prove it is always core-stable, at the cost of dominant-strategy incentive compatibility. Illustrative examples accompany each result.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在具有传输成本的容量受限流网络中，端节点之间的路径集合分配问题。我们提出了一种起点-终点（OD）竞价语言，参与者通过该语言竞标入口-出口-数量许可证的有界锥形组合，而机制则通过网络流优化来决定最优路径。随后，我们探讨了OD机制的支付规则。在一种受限模型中，当气体来源对投标者来说是公开且价格统一的，并且投标者对气体来源无差别时，Vickrey-Clarke-Groves（VCG）支付规则是核心稳定的；关键的结构特征在于，在这种情形下，某些最优总流量永远不会同时使用双向的物理管道，因此路径选择问题简化为单一商品的网络流问题，其价值在活跃投标者集合中是次模的。如果允许气体来源的使用权取决于个别消费者（例如在涉及双边政治谈判的气体交易中），这种简化就不成立，VCG支付规则可能会完全偏离核心区域。对于这种一般模型，我们提出了一种基于流量守恒约束的影子价格推导出的双重（节点）定价规则，并证明了该规则始终是核心稳定的，但代价是牺牲了占优策略下的激励相容性。每个研究结果都附有相应的示例说明。。

papers.title: Data-Driven Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Vine Copula Simulation and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We develop a data-driven approach to dynamic portfolio selection that combines vine-copula simulation with reinforcement learning. The investor has constant relative risk aversion and maximises expected terminal utility with a running penalty on the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of one-period losses. We estimate a conditional vine model from historical returns and use it to generate joint scenarios for CVaR evaluation and conditional paths for training a recurrent portfolio policy. Under uniform local derivative bounds, we propagate edgewise pair-copula parameter errors through the conditional transforms to obtain power-law stability bounds in Hellinger distance and total variation. In a finite-horizon investment model, we combine these estimates with a marginal and structural approximation budget to bound policy values, optimal values and the true-market loss of policies selected under a fitted model, with separate simulation and numerical optimisation terms. On a seven-asset panel comprising US and Chinese equities and gold, the selected ensemble of ten trained policies achieves a compound annual growth rate of 34.13% and a Sharpe ratio of 2.31 over 22 complete monthly holding periods, exceeding the corresponding values of six classical and vine-based benchmarks. Combining simulated and historical training data reduces monthly target-to-target turnover by 41.5% relative to training on historical data alone, while maintaining comparable growth.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种基于数据驱动的动态投资组合选择方法，该方法将藤copula模拟与强化学习相结合。投资者具有恒定的相对风险厌恶偏好，并在考虑单期损失的条件风险价值（CVaR）的持续惩罚下，最大化预期终值效用。我们利用历史收益率估计出一个条件藤模型，并用该模型生成用于CVaR评估的联合情景以及用于训练循环投资组合策略的条件路径。在局部导数界限均匀的情况下，我们通过条件变换逐层传播copula参数的误差，从而获得Hellinger距离和总变分的幂律稳定性界限。在有限期限的投资模型中，我们将这些估计结果与边际和结构近似方法相结合，以限定策略价值、最优价值以及基于拟合模型选定的策略在真实市场中的损失；同时采用模拟和数值优化手段进行评估。在一个包含美国和中国股票及黄金的七资产投资组合中，经过训练的十种策略组合在22个完整的月度持有期内实现了34.13%的复合年增长率和2.31的夏普比率，超过了六种传统投资组合模型和基于藤copula模型的相应表现。与仅使用历史数据进行训练相比，结合模拟数据和历史训练数据可将每月资产周转率降低41.5%，同时保持相似的增长率。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Interior smoothness and zero-variance geometry for finite-maturity Heston American puts
papers.abstract: We study finite-maturity American puts in the Heston model without the Feller condition. At positive variance, the exercise boundary is smooth and strictly decreasing in remaining maturity and variance. At zero variance, the endpoint is locally Lipschitz in remaining maturity, the boundary moves with bounded speed in maturity uniformly down to zero variance, and it extends continuously to the axis. Each boundary slice at positive maturity has a regular $C^1$ closure tangent to the zero-variance axis, its stock threshold has variance derivative tending to minus infinity, and both partial derivatives of the inverse boundary graph vanish along the slice. The continuation premium at the axis contact stock is of order variance, and as a consequence smooth fit fails in the variance direction at the axis. At expiry the whole boundary, including its axis edge, converges to the strike. We give quantitative boundary gap bounds, an exact limiting weighted boundary Hessian, and vertical identities retaining the maturity term. Exact boundary gap equivalents remain open.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了在未满足Feller条件的Heston模型中，有限到期日的美式看跌期权的行为。当方差为正时，行权边界是光滑的，并且随着剩余到期时间和方差的增加而严格递减；当方差为零时，行权边界在剩余到期时间上具有局部Lipschitz性质，边界以有界速度沿到期时间方向向零方差方向移动，并且能够连续延伸至坐标轴。在正到期时间范围内，每个边界切片都具有一个规则的$C^1$闭包，该闭包与零方差轴相切；其股票执行价格对应的方差导数趋于负无穷大；同时，逆边界图的偏导数在该切片上为零。在坐标轴处，期权价格与股票价格的连续性依赖于方差的大小，因此在方差方向上无法实现光滑拟合。到期时，整个边界（包括其轴边缘）都会收敛至执行价格。我们给出了边界间隙的定量界限、精确的极限加权边界Hessian矩阵，以及保持到期时间项不变的垂直性质表达式。关于边界间隙的精确等价关系问题目前仍待进一步研究。。

papers.title: Which Text Matters: Handling Model Uncertainty in Text-as-Data Regressions, with an Application to Central Bank Communication
papers.abstract: Social scientists routinely convert text into covariates like topic shares, ideal points or sentiment scores, and insert them into statistical models of interest. This two-step design is convenient, but it is rarely guided by theory: little tells the analyst which text-based covariates to construct or include. Each approach embodies contestable measurement choices, and competing operationalizations of the same construct can support different conclusions, so a single research question gives rise to a menu of competing regression models. Which text constructed covariates belong in a model, and in what functional form, is thus a problem of model uncertainty. We propose spike-and-slab generalized additive models (SSGAMs), which jointly select covariates and determine whether their effects are linear or nonlinear. We illustrate the approach with the communication of a powerful unelected institution, asking which of 45 competing text indicators from 224 monthly European Central Bank press conferences, spanning late 2002 to mid-2025, track professional inflation expectations. A sparse set is selected; widely used alternatives, and every tested nonlinear effect, carry no incremental information.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】社会科学家通常会将文本转化为诸如主题占比、理想点或情感得分之类的协变量，并将其纳入感兴趣的统计模型中。这种两步设计虽然便捷，但很少基于理论进行指导：分析师很难确定应构建或包含哪些基于文本的协变量。每种方法都包含可争议的测量选择，对于同一概念的不同操作化方式可能会得出不同的结论，因此同一个研究问题往往会产生多种相互竞争的回归模型。因此，哪些基于文本的协变量应该被纳入模型以及以何种形式纳入，属于模型不确定性的范畴。我们提出了“尖峰-平板广义加性模型”（SSGAMs），该模型能够同时选择协变量并判断其效应是线性的还是非线性的。我们通过分析一个具有强大影响力的非选举产生机构的沟通内容来说明这一方法的应用实例，具体考察了2002年末至2025年中期期间，来自欧洲中央银行224次月度新闻发布会的45个文本指标中，哪些指标能够有效反映专业通胀预期。最终只选择了一小部分指标；那些被广泛使用的替代指标以及所有经过测试的非线性效应均未能提供额外的信息。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Building a Sovereign Benchmark The Limits of Private Coordination
papers.abstract: Public debt supplies liquidity and collateral services only if institutions coordinate on using the same claim. We study this coordination when use carries a recurring cost and a benefit that rises with other users. Above a quality threshold, two positive-adoption equilibria exist, and under best responses the initial user base decides between collapse and high adoption. Under logit choice, as the population grows and noise vanishes, the long-run distribution selects high adoption only above a strictly higher threshold. Debt issuance improves market depth but eventually dilutes backing per claim. This trade-off creates a range of debt levels supporting the liquidity premium of public debt in macroeconomic models and a narrower range supporting its long-run selection. At the boundary of the wider range, the premium is discontinuous. A matching transfer that corrects the adoption externality makes stationary selection maximize network surplus. Transfers can also help launch a network without permanent support.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】公共债务只有在相关机构就同一债权的使用方式达成协调时，才能提供流动性及抵押支持功能。我们研究了在使用权存在重复成本且其收益随使用者数量增加而提升的情况下，这种协调机制的运作情况。当债权质量达到某一阈值以上时，系统会存在两种不同的采纳均衡状态；在最佳响应策略下，初始使用者群体需要在系统崩溃与高采纳率之间做出选择。在采用逻辑斯蒂（logit）选择模型时，随着人口规模的扩大和噪声因素的减少，长期市场分布仅会在更高的质量阈值下才会呈现出高采纳率。债务发行虽然提升了市场深度，但最终会稀释每项债权的支撑力度。这种权衡机制解释了宏观经济模型中公共债务流动性溢价的存在范围，以及其长期被选择的有限性。在较宽选择范围的边界处，流动性溢价呈现出不连续性。通过实施适当的转移支付来纠正采纳行为的外部性，可以使系统达到稳定状态并实现网络盈余的最大化；此外，转移支付还有助于在没有持续外部支持的情况下推动网络的建立与发展。。

papers.title: Rewarding Noise: Incentives in Decentralized A/B Testing
papers.abstract: Many firms that run A/B tests struggle with low statistical power, increasing the risk that launch decisions are driven by noise rather than true impact. We argue that in decentralized organizations, low power can reflect misaligned incentives: product teams choose what and how to test on a customer-facing experience to maximize their private reward, while the experience owner sets evaluation rules and launch criteria to optimize the experience. We formalize this interaction via a principal-agent model and show that evaluating tests using raw impact estimates creates a reward to sampling noise. Correctly calibrated posterior-mean evaluation removes this reward and creates a local incentive to reallocate toward fewer, more precise tests of more ambitious ideas. Using data on A/B tests run at Amazon, we document patterns consistent with these model predictions. After an Amazon experience shifted to posterior-mean-based evaluation in 2024, test volume declined while both precision and the dispersion of true impacts increased, more than doubling signal-to-noise ratios. Our results highlight that A/B testing methodologies can shape not only measurement and launch decisions, but which tests are pursued in the first place.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】许多进行A/B测试的公司都面临着统计功效较低的问题，这增加了决策失误的可能性——这些决策可能是受到随机因素的影响，而非真正的产品效果所驱动。我们认为，在去中心化的组织结构中，统计功效低可能反映了激励机制的不一致：产品团队为了最大化自身的私利，会自行决定测试的内容和方式；而体验的负责人则负责制定评估规则和发布标准，以优化用户体验。我们通过一个委托-代理模型来阐述这种互动关系，并指出，如果仅依据原始的数据估计结果来评估测试效果，实际上会为随机误差提供正向激励。通过正确校准后的后验均值评估方法，可以消除这种激励机制，从而促使资源重新分配到数量更少、但更具针对性的测试项目上，进而推动更具有创新性的想法得以实现。利用亚马逊实际进行的A/B测试数据，我们发现了与模型预测一致的现象：2024年亚马逊开始采用基于后验均值的评估方式后，测试数量减少了，但测试结果的精确度以及真实效果的离散度却提高了，信噪比提升了一倍多。我们的研究结果表明，A/B测试方法不仅会影响测量和发布决策，还会影响最初选择进行哪些测试。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Who Keeps a Bubble Alive? Skin in the Game and the Survival of Rational Bubbles
papers.abstract: We study how retained ownership supports the value of an asset that pays no dividends and is held only for resale. A sponsor chooses hidden maintenance that determines market survival, bears its full cost, and captures only the benefit accruing to its retained tokens. A positive stationary equilibrium exists if and only if retention meets an endogenous minimum. Under additional curvature restrictions, retention above this threshold supports two positive stationary equilibria. Conditional on survival, prices below the upper equilibrium converge to the lower one while the upper price is the largest feasible initial valuation. Greater retention expands the feasible price interval. Credible news that future retention will be below the minimum causes an immediate collapse through backward unraveling. The model identifies a governance channel through which insider unlocks can affect valuation without changing total token supply or fundamental cash flows.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了保留所有权如何支持一种不支付股息、仅用于转售的资产的价值。发起人选择一种隐蔽的维护策略，该策略决定了资产在市场上的存续情况，其全部成本由发起人承担，而发起人仅能获得与其保留的代币相关的收益。当保留比例达到某个内生最低阈值时，才会存在一个正的稳态均衡。在额外的约束条件下（如市场曲率限制），当保留比例超过该阈值时，会存在两个正的稳态均衡。在资产存续的前提下，低于较高均衡的价格会收敛到较低均衡的价格；而较高价格则是所有可能的初始估值中最大的一个。较高的保留比例会扩大可行的价格区间。如果传出可信的消息表明未来的保留比例将低于最低阈值，市场会因“反向解体”效应而立即崩溃。该模型揭示了一种治理机制：内部人士可以通过这种机制影响资产估值，而无需改变代币的总供应量或资产的根本现金流。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Common Signals, Spurious Cross-Excitation, and Identification in Multivariate Hawkes Processes
papers.abstract: Multivariate Hawkes models are widely used to measure endogenous interactions in event data, but latent common signals can generate apparent excitation even without structural interaction. We characterize the resulting linear projection and construct stable, nonnegative Hawkes processes that share the mean intensity and Bartlett spectrum of common-signal models despite having different excitation mechanisms. This establishes a concrete form of second-order non-identification. We derive integrated third-order cumulants for Hawkes processes with Cox immigration and establish generic local identification of normalized structural parameters in two- and three-dimensional systems. An exact-equivalence Monte Carlo experiment demonstrates how third-order information can distinguish mechanisms with identical second-order structure, while revealing substantial finite-sample limitations under weak signals. For a restricted parametric family, we develop Whittle estimation from binned counts, establish consistency and asymptotic normality under appropriate identification conditions, and construct feasible sandwich standard errors accounting for estimated mean intensities. Simulations assess structural recovery and inference accuracy. An application to cryptocurrency transactions illustrates the sensitivity of inferred excitation to model specification and the limitations of structural interpretation based on spectral fit alone.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】多元Hawkes模型被广泛用于测量事件数据中的内生交互作用，但潜在的共同信号即使在没有结构交互作用的情况下也可能产生明显的激发效应。我们描述了由此产生的线性投影，并构建了稳定的、非负的Hawkes过程，这些过程尽管具有不同的激发机制，但仍具有共同信号模型的平均强度和Bartlett谱特性。这揭示了一种具体的二阶非识别现象。我们为具有Cox迁移机制的Hawkes过程推导出了积分三阶累积量，并在二维和三维系统中建立了对标准化结构参数的通用局部识别方法。通过精确等价性的蒙特卡洛实验表明，三阶信息能够区分具有相同二阶结构的机制，但在信号较弱的情况下也会暴露出显著的有限样本局限性。对于一个受限的参数族，我们基于分箱计数数据开发了Whittle估计方法，在适当的识别条件下证明了该方法的一致性和渐近正态性，并构建了考虑估计平均强度的可行三明治标准误差。模拟实验评估了结构信息的恢复能力和推断精度。将这种方法应用于加密货币交易数据，展示了推断出的激发效应对模型设定的敏感性，以及仅基于谱拟合进行结构解释的局限性。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Beyond Time Induction: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers for Parametric Stochastic-Volatility Pricing
papers.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks provide a flexible framework for learning parametric PDE solution families without labeled data, yet preserving accurate derivatives across heterogeneous regimes remains challenging. Structured neural solvers offer compact representations, but restrictive conditional parameterizations can limit adaptation across the solution family. We introduce BeTINN, a structured conditional architecture extending time-induced modulation through multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway. We evaluate BeTINN on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, a demanding parametric problem with mixed derivatives and economically relevant first- and second-order sensitivities. BeTINN improves joint accuracy across normalized option value and key sensitivity metrics relative to our baselines. Controlled ablations characterize the roles of its architectural components. We further find that validation physics loss is informative but does not fully determine differential fidelity, and that accurate solution values can coexist with localized derivative errors. These results support structured conditional adaptation and motivate derivative-aware evaluation when sensitivities are downstream quantities of interest.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】物理信息神经网络（Physics-informed neural networks）为在无标签数据的情况下学习参数化偏微分方程（parametric PDE）解的族提供了灵活的框架，然而在异构条件下保持导数的准确性仍然具有挑战性。结构化的神经求解器（structured neural solvers）能够实现紧凑的表示，但受限的条件参数化可能会限制解的族在不同条件下的适应性。我们提出了BeTINN，这是一种结构化的条件架构，通过多方向的时间参数调节（time-parameter conditioning）和联合残差路径（joint residual pathway）来实现时间诱导的调制（time-induced modulation）。我们在Heston随机波动率偏微分方程（Heston stochastic-volatility PDE）上对BeTINN进行了评估，这是一个具有混合导数以及经济上重要的一阶和二阶敏感性的复杂参数化问题。与基线方法相比，BeTINN在标准化期权价值（normalized option value）和关键敏感性指标（key sensitivity m...。研究方法：神经网络、随机过程。
